title: SugarCraft — SugarIgnore
description: SugarIgnore: gitignore-style ignore matching over injected file contents (no IO) — negation, dir-only, anchoring, **, escapes, nested ignore files, .git/info/exclude precedence, and a backtrack-free matcher that fails closed on hostile patterns. Extracted from candy-code; first-party.
ogDescription: One ignore engine for every tool that walks a repository: hand it the ignore files' contents, ask whether a path is ignored, and get the deciding rule back — safe against hostile patterns.
tagline: gitignore matching over injected contents — fails closed on hostile patterns
